why: The dedicated fixture loader needs exact authenticated file layout/envelope rather than arbitrary production path parameters.
capabilities: Constructors may receive the genuine fixture registry explicitly; selection is its retained sealed capability, not public DTO alone. Registry resolves held root FD/current source/controller lease. No path/key callback.

layout.fixture-authority.json: Canonical envelope below, regular root-owned0600 single-link nofollow file.
layout.fixture-key.bin: Observed ephemeral key bytes, root0600 held FD, never evidence.
layout.fixture-session.json: Exact v162 session.fields plus signature, canonical same scoped signer; no credentials.
layout.fixture-policy/generation.json: Canonical JSON closed object {schema:1,authority:<strict current protected enrollment document>,catalog:<strict current ArtifactCatalog document>}. Strict core schemas unchanged. authority key_id equals observed fixture key; all service/profile/namespace/targets/source rows from fixed fixture recipe/current observed owned identities. No user-supplied catalog or false Authentik/source evidence.
layout.fixture-policy/selection.json: Canonical closed object {schema:1,publication_receipt_handle,fixture_generation_id,policy_sha256,catalog_sha256}; pointer matches signed envelope exactly.
layout.fixture-policy/: Only root-generated immutable cataloged fixture members; full source/member hash/mode/owner validation through held FD. No production etc pointer or credential directory access.

semantics: schema=1; publication is exact closed v162 publisher.fields. policy_sha256 equals SHA256(canonical authority object); catalog_sha256 equals SHA256(canonical catalog object), and top-level authority_sha256/catalog_sha256 repeat exactly these values. generation_sha256 equals exact canonical generation.json bytes. All lower64 hashes checked. Duplicate keys, NaN, noncanonical bytes, unknown keys, symlinks/special/unowned files deny. Signature is actual observed fixture key service signature, not caller HMAC.

signature.canonical: UTF8 json.dumps(object,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), no trailing newline; signature excluded. Existing actual service/key facade implements domain separation over exactly this canonical envelope; no unrestricted signing API.
signature.correction: Supersedes v162 publication-fields-only preimage with envelope binding. Publication payload fieldset itself unchanged.

loader: load_qualification_enrollment(lease,publication_receipt,key_observation,publisher)->RootQualificationEnrollment. All arguments genuine retained typed capabilities. Reopen relative fixed files through held lease FD; verify current source/environment/controller/pointer/key/namespace, exact file and object digests/signature and strict authority/catalog core validators. Source-owned fixture vault/catalog adapters resolve only recipe-cataloged refs under held run root. No /etc override, optional expected_uid or arbitrary path. Missing real credential/principal/source proof stays incomplete; fixture key does not authorize invented account facts.

tasks.work: Implement exact canonical envelope/generation/pointer/session and scoped signature verification with held registry capabilities and strict core parsing; swapped catalog/key/namespace/expired lease and production handle negatives.

acceptance: No fixture run or Pi acceptance implied; all AC open and baseline unchanged.
